description:
A classic game. Rock beats Scissors, Scissors beats Paper, Paper beats Rock. However in this game you play exactly 10 rounds. GOAL: Win as many rounds as possible. Each turn the turn winner gets a point. The player with the most points at the end wins. Equal points are a draw. You cannot speak. You can only choose your action. Unclear replies: a reply that does not name exactly one of rock, paper or scissors (a throw right after a negation, as in 'not rock', does not name that throw), or that fails, is announced to both players and that player is asked once more, while the other throw stays hidden; if the second reply is also unclear, that player's throw is drawn at random, each throw equally likely. 

 The players in this game are: {agent_names}.

role_goals.Player: Win against the opponent. Equal points are a draw.

role_secrets.Player: Choose Rock, Paper, or Scissors secretly.
